messages:
maya: Hey all — I'm on my first rotation starting Mon. Quick questions: who owns the shadow handoff checklist, where do I sign up for the incident sim exercises, and I still can't see PagerDuty. @ravi ?

ravi: Hey @maya — added you to PagerDuty just now, you should get an invite email. If not, ping me and I'll re-send. Shadow handoff checklist lives in the runbooks repo (link below).

alex: I can do a shadow session Mon 09:30-10:15 if that helps. We usually run through a golden-path sim: alert -> triage -> mitigation -> postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:

sam: FYI the sim sign-up sheet is Google Forms: https://go/rw-oncall-sims — pick a slot and put your GitHub handle. We cap at 6 ppl per sim to keep it realistic.

lee: Also add yourself to #incidents-watcher for passive alerts during shadow week. You won't get pages there but you'll see the channels/events.

maya: Thanks — I found the runbook link but the checklist is a little terse. Any quick starter steps I should run through before shadow?

alex: Short checklist I run:
1) Confirm PD access + test notification on your phone (low priority test alert)
2) Confirm access to runbooks and creds vault (read-only)
3) Spin up local dev reenact (see snippet)
4) Walk through one closed incident (read notes)

alex: Snippet to run the local reenact (from runbooks):
```bash
# repro a high cpu alert locally (dev cluster)
kubectl apply -f tools/load-gen.yaml -n dev-test
sleep 30
kubectl logs -f deploy/load-gen -n dev-test
```

ravi: If you need vault access, put a request in the infra-access queue with justification and I'll expedite. Also note: don't use production credentials during sims.

oncall-coordinator: @maya added to "shadow-week: 2026-05-11" in the calendar and assigned alex as primary buddy. Sim slot on Tue 2026-05-12 14:00-15:00 reserved. Reminder: please complete the orientation checklist before your first shadow: https://go/rw-oncall-checklist

maya: Awesome — one last thing: in case I get a pager during shadow, what's the expected escalation pattern? Quick bullets would help.

lee: Escalation pattern (short):
- Attempt first-response (15 min): triage + ack in PD
- If not resolved in 20 min -> notify secondary on PD and post in #incidents
- If impact > P1 or customer-facing within 30 min -> call the on-call lead and start incident channel template
- Document every action in the incident doc and add postmortem owners within 48h

sam: We'll run a mini mock during your shadow so you can practice the flow. No surprises, just a drill. :muscle:

maya: Thanks team — I'll fill the sim form and scope out the checklist tonight. Appreciate the help!

sre-bot: Rotation updated: maya added to PagerDuty rotation week starting 2026-05-11. Notification sent to: maya, alex, ravi.
